source_evidence_candidates.exact_quote:
The paper presents an evaluation of popular robotics tools available for educators to use in the
classroom as part of a larger project called "INBOTS: Inclusive Robotics for a Better Society". The
evaluation focused on how the tool can promote learning opportunities for all students inclusively.
The author came up with a set of eight criteria to assess the inclusiveness of those tools evaluated.
